UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's profile and calling/data-saver settings.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: User's verified Google email address (owner-only PII).

lowDataCallsEnabled.description: Whether low-data calling mode is enabled.

lowLatencyEnabled.description: Whether low-latency routing optimization is enabled.

totalDataSavedMb.description: Cumulative estimated data saved in megabytes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) updated on each change.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: A user's chat and call contact added by Gmail address.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

avatarColorHex.description: ARGB color integer for the contact avatar.

online.description: Whether the contact is currently online.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A text chat message belonging to a specific contact conversation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

contactId.description: ID of the parent contact document.

senderId.description: Identifier of the sender (current_user or contact ID).

reactions.description: Map of emoji string to reaction count.

encrypted.description: Whether the message is marked end-to-end encrypted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) updated on status/reaction change.

CallLog.title: CallLog
CallLog.description: Immutable call history entry for audio or video calls.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

contactName.description: Snapshot display name of the contact.

contactAvatarColorHex.description: Snapshot ARGB avatar color of the contact.

callType.description: Whether the call was audio or video.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the call in seconds.

lowDataMode.description: Whether low-data mode was enabled for the call.

encrypted.description: Whether the call was end-to-end encrypted.

UserDirectoryEntry.title: UserDirectoryEntry
UserDirectoryEntry.description: Privacy-preserving exact-match directory record keyed by the SHA-256 hash of a verified user's lowercase Gmail address. Stores no email/PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered user.

displayName.description: Public display name shown when another user looks up this email.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) updated when display name changes.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and app preferences.

/userDirectory/{emailHash}.description: Hashed exact-match lookup directory allowing signed-in users to find registered users by SHA-256(email) without exposing emails or allowing enumeration.

/users/{userId}/contacts/{contactId}.description: Contacts saved by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/contacts/{contactId}/mes.description: Text chat messages within a contact conversation.

/users/{userId}/callLogs/{callLogId}.description: Immutable call history logs for the authenticated user.
